text: grep -rn "fn closure_signature_from_ast" -A50 src/ | head -60: -/// Returns a direct closure return expression type, consulting capture and parameter src/ir_lower/function.rs-1813-/// metadata first. A bare `return $x` where `$x` is a parameter must adopt the parameter's src/ir_lower/function.rs-1814-/// declared type (e.g. `mixed`) rather than falling back to the syntactic integer default, src/ir_lower/function.rs-1815-/// which would otherwise coerce a boxed Mixed argument to an integer on return. A src/ir_lower/function.rs-1816-/// `return $obj->prop` where `$obj` is a captured/parameter object of a known class adopts src/ir_lower/function.rs-1817-/// the property's declared type, so a `fn &() => $o->items` closure returns the array type src/ir_lower/function.rs-1818-/// rather than the syntactic integer default.
